paragraphs.text: The proposer offers a two-section 15 kV arc-resistant metal-clad switchgear lineup, which complies with the specifications outlined in the RFP. This lineup includes eighteen 15 kV vacuum circuit breaker positions equipped with protective relays and controls, two revenue meter positions, two sets of 15 kV isolation switches, bus voltage transformers (VTs), and multi-ratio current transformers (CTs). Future bays are provided fully functional, excluding the vacuum circuit breakers (VCBs).

The vacuum circuit breakers included in the switchgear lineup are tested and rated in accordance with NEMA SG 4 standards for alternating-current high voltage circuit breakers, ensuring compliance with the RFP requirements.
Additionally, the proposer will supply and install a battery charger for the auxiliary power system, connecting it to panel LP-1 via new conduit as specified in the RFP.
